dedupe_keys.name: a data driven plastic hinge length prediction model for rectangular reinforced concrete columns

description: A Data-Driven Plastic Hinge Length Prediction Model for Rectangular Reinforced Concrete Columns is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ertugrul Taciroglu, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). Inelastic response of reinforced concrete columns to combined axial and flexural loading is characterized by plastic deformations localized in small regions, which are idealized as plastic hinges. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-cy48-d115. Keywords: Plastic hinge length, RC columns, Machine learning, Adaptive boosting, Fiber element analysis, Opensees. Published 2020-06-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
